ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) central region versus 25% high-intensity (white) distal lobe patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct contiguous white patches on the distal lateral margins of both lobes. The left lobe features a large triangular white region with internal dark speckling. The right lobe shows a more fragmented white region with significant dark pixel intrusions and mottled borders.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration along the entire visible boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer lateral thirds of each lobe, forming a jagged sawtooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the leading edges, tapering to sharp distal tips with an upward curvature on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 10-12 small circular white pixel clusters (scars) scattered across the dark central and lower-left quadrant of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular nicks and small notches at the distal tips of the trailing edges, particularly on the right side, which break the consistent serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical dark pigmentation streak penetrating the white patch on the left lobe, and an isolated dark 'island' within the white region of the right lobe.
